demoBanner: Demo version: all people and data shown are fictional.

unreachable.title: The server can’t be reached
unreachable.text: The app could not reach Med Connect at {address}. In the demo, the phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as the computer that runs it.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the same email and password as on the Med Connect site.
signIn.codeIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
signIn.join: Not registered yet? Open an account

home.title: Med Connect
home.staffNote: You have a staff role. The admin area is on the website; the app is for everyday use.
home.none: You have no membership yet. Joining is done on the website.
home.unread: {count, plural, =0 {No unread notifications} one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}

language.title: Language
language.restart: The direction of the text changes with the language. Close the app and open it again to finish the change.

account.signOutEverywhereHint: Ends every session of your account: this phone, other phones and browsers.

lock.title: Unlock Med Connect
lock.failed: The phone did not recognise you. Try again, or sign out.
lock.setting: Ask for my fingerprint or face when the app opens
lock.settingHint: Uses the lock your phone already has. Nothing about your fingerprint or face leaves the phone.
lock.notAvailable: This phone has no fingerprint or face unlock set up, so the app opens without asking.

check.title: Connection check
check.intro: For the first test on your phone: whether live updates (used by chat) arrive.
check.running: Listening, for up to thirty seconds…
check.ok: Live updates arrive on this phone.
check.failed: Live updates did not arrive. Chat will ask the server every few seconds instead.

card.offline: No connection. This is your card as it was on {date}. The code can’t be shown without a connection, because it changes every few minutes.
card.brightness: Turn the screen’s brightness up if the code doesn’t scan.

events.calendarFailed: The calendar file couldn’t be saved.

notices.onSite: This one opens on the website.

chat.noCamera: The app may not use the camera. You can allow it in the phone’s settings.

security.openApp: Your authenticator app is on this phone, so there is no code to scan. Open it from here, or type the key below into it.

passkeys.intro: A passkey signs you in without a password, with your fingerprint, face or the phone’s screen lock. It also counts as two-step verification. A passkey made on the site works here too, if it is synced to this phone.
passkeys.unsupported: This phone can’t use passkeys. They need a screen lock and Google Play services. Sign in with your password.
passkeys.none: This phone has no passkey for Med Connect. Sign in with your password, then add one under Security.

scan.title: Scan a code
scan.intro: Point the camera at the code shown at an event’s venue to record your attendance, or at the code on a membership card to check it.
scan.permission: The app needs the camera to read a code. Nothing is photographed or kept.
scan.camera: The camera, looking for a code
scan.unknown: This is not a code of Med Connect.

guest.intro: You are not signed in. News, events, guidelines and the open part of the education library can be read without an account.
guest.linkOpensSite: Open the link in the email on this phone to finish in the app, or on a computer to finish on the website.
guest.afterVerify: After your address is verified, sign in here and apply for membership under “Me” → “My application”.

research.publicationsHint: Add your publications, and choose their order.
